findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.lookup' class Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookUp differs in letter case from the real file src/WidgetLookup.php: the autoloader fails on case-sensitive filesystems (Linux servers, DDEV).
findings.suggestion: Use the exact class name: Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookup.

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.legacy_exporter' points at class Drupal\legacy_widgets\Export\LegacyExporter, but src/Export/LegacyExporter.php does not exist (orphan service): fetching it is a fatal error.
findings.suggestion: Remove the service definition, or restore/rename the class.

findings.message: Config 'legacy_widgets.settings' has no schema in config/schema/*.schema.yml: strict config schema checks (Kernel/Functional tests, config inspector) fail on it and its values are not typed or translatable.
findings.suggestion: Add a 'legacy_widgets.settings:' entry (type: config_object for simple config) to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml.

findings.message: configure: 'legacy_widgets.settings' names a route that no *.routing.yml of the extension defines: core drops the Configure link from /admin/modules silently (unless a route subscriber or another module provides it).
findings.suggestion: Point it at the real route ('legacy_widgets.settings_form'?).

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.counter' passes 3 argument(s) but Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetCounter::__construct() takes 2: PHP silently ignores the extra one(s) (a stale argument, or a constructor that lost a parameter).
findings.suggestion: Drop the extra argument(s), or restore the constructor parameter they were meant for.

findings.message: Condition plugin 'legacy_widgets_enabled' has its own settings but no 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled' schema: only core's generic 'condition.plugin.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Filter plugin 'legacy_widgets_summary' has its own settings but no 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary' schema: only core's generic 'filter_settings.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Submodule 'legacy_widgets_extra' declares core_version_requirement: ^8.8 || ^9 || ^10, which does not admit Drupal 11: core marks it incompatible and it cannot be installed.
findings.suggestion: Set it to the parent's constraint ('^10'): /drupilot-port does this with set-core-requirement.sh.

findings.message: 'legacy_widgets_extra' uses project module 'legacy_widgets' (class,service) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
'legacy_widgets_extra' uses core module 'node' (class) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
'Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookUp' does not match the real file 'src/WidgetLookup.php' (case differs): works on a case-insensitive filesystem, fatals on Linux.

WidgetImportForm::$entityTypeManager is a private readonly promoted property in a class using DependencySerializationTrait - readonly: __wakeup() cannot re-initialize it ('Cannot initialize readonly property'); private: __sleep() runs in the base-class scope and drops it ('must not be accessed before initialization' after unserialize). Use protected, non-readonly.

WidgetImportForm::$loggerFactory is a private readonly promoted property in a class using DependencySerializationTrait - readonly: __wakeup() cannot re-initialize it ('Cannot initialize readonly property'); private: __sleep() runs in the base-class scope and drops it ('must not be accessed before initialization' after unserialize). Use protected, non-readonly.

findings.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.
findings.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
findings.message: legacy_widgets_entity_operation() implements hook_entity_operation(), which core invokes with 2 argument(s) from Drupal 11.3; the current 1-parameter form works on every core. If you accept the new parameter, keep it optional while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.

findings.fix: While the floor is below 11.2: keep the ->original property, or wrap the call in DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall() (core 10.1+): backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.2', fn() => $entity->getOriginal(), fn() => $entity->original). Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.
findings.message: EntityInterface::getOriginal()/setOriginal() exists only from Drupal 11.2, below the core floor (10.0): a fatal on older cores unless the receiver is the module's own class. Guard it (DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall) or raise the floor to ^11.2.

findings.d10_compat: Core's getOriginal() does not exist below 11.2: code kept for ^10 must not call it on core entities (use the deprecated ->original property, or DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall()).
findings.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
findings.message: LegacyWidget::getOriginal() collides with core's EntityInterface::getOriginal() added in Drupal 11.2 and is incompatible (return type 'none' (core: ?static or static)): a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' when the class loads on 11.2+.

findings.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.2+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older 10.x/9.x cores.
findings.fix: Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container->get('config.typed') from create().
findings.message: SettingsForm::__construct() passes 1 argument(s) to ConfigFormBase::__construct(), which requires 2 from Drupal 11.0: ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.

findings.d10_compat: Never add #[\Override] to it while the core floor is below 11.3: the parent method does not exist there and PHP 8.3+ fatals at compile time.
findings.fix: Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.
findings.message: LegacyWidgetStorage::buildRevisionCacheId() is a module method below Drupal 11.3 and silently OVERRIDES core's ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId() from 11.3 (core calls it). Rename it unless that override is intended; never mark it with the Override attribute while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.
